_comment: Issue #97: FIXTURE-FIRST start for pallass_watchgolem_loop -- the accept-fight-turnin loop for bounty_watchgolem_cull, Pallass's own posting-machine proof (2 new combat encounters this task, forge_calibration_golem + market_watchgolems; this canonical exercises the market pair, which showcases the new `guard` AI profile).
